notes.title: B737 fuselage train in Augmented Reality
notes.notes:
Face-to-face with a B737 fuselage train in Augmented Reality.
As we explained in the first level of our upcoming game, those trains start their journey in Wichita, Kansas and travel to Renton, Washington.
This is the exact same 3D model we use in our game.

You can view it in your browser or in Augmented Reality on your phone/tablet by using the following link (no download needed): https://bit.ly/3kvYOD2

The game is coming in September 2020.
Please buy or add to your wishlist.

[previewyoutube=dTZbEB9HdZs;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Launch America - Augmented Reality
notes.notes:
